native_context: Cloud Firestore rules, caller identity and document mutations
taxonomy_note: Planning compatibility lens only. Classify the final observed root cause independently; unsupported mappings stay unassigned.

controls.boundary: Cloud Firestore rules, caller identity and document mutations — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Read deployed rules, query shape, document paths, authentication claims and authoritative membership fields. Distinguish client SDK rules from privileged server SDK/IAM access.
controls.controlled_verification: Use a local rules emulator or owned fixtures with A/B tenants. Compare a normal A query/read with a B document/query and inspect whether caller-writable document fields can manufacture the membership condition. Exercise writes against both existing and proposed document state where relevant.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Rules do not filter an arbitrary result set like application code; query compatibility matters. A server SDK bypassing client rules is expected and needs its own IAM/application authorization analysis.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind document/query/write authority to trusted identity and protected membership state. Retest allowed query shapes, denied cross-tenant reads and writes that try to change authority fields.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
